name: lead-enrichment-multi-agent-system
description: Universal portable multi-agent plugin for Claude Code, Antigravity, Copilot, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness. Ingests raw Meta Ads CSV, deduplicates advertisers, dynamically shards workload across Manager Pods with Semaphore(4) throttling, executes parallel research and headless vision/CAPI audits via MCP tools, qualifies leads against user-provided Qualification.md, and synthesizes 4-part Jeremy Miner NEPQ cold call battlecards into Clean_Enriched_Leads.csv.
author: Autonomous Agency Architect

facebook-ads-library.description: Live Facebook Meta Ads Library verification and competitor intelligence

agent-reach.description: Social media channel verification and multi-touchpoint reachability checks

playwright.description: Headless browser audits for Core Web Vitals (LCP/FID/CLS) and Meta Pixel/CAPI telemetry

inputs.raw_csv: RAW.csv or sample_meta_ads.csv (Meta Ads Library raw multi-row export)
inputs.qualification_spec: Qualification.md (User-defined qualification criteria, thresholds & NEPQ directives)

outputs.briefing: Top Tier A Hot Leads Summary with instant Jeremy Miner NEPQ Call Openers
